tools.name: check_feed
tools.description: Fetch an RSS, Atom or JSON Feed address live and validate it. Returns whether it is valid, the feed title and website link, format, number of items, date of the newest item, how many days ago that was, whether the feed is still active (an item in the last 90 days), the publishing pace, and the error

tools.name: latest_items
tools.description: Read the most recent items of an RSS, Atom or JSON feed, fetched live. Returns up to 20 items with title, link, publication date and a short plain text summary (HTML removed). Use to answer "what did this site publish lately" or to preview a feed before subscribing.

tools.name: discover_feeds
tools.description: Find the RSS, Atom or JSON feeds of a website. Reads the page for <link rel="alternate"> feed tags, knows the feed patterns of big platforms (YouTube channels and playlists, Reddit, Medium, Substack, GitHub, Tumblr, Bluesky, Stack Overflow, Apple Podcasts) and tries common feed paths such as /feed a

tools.name: search_directory
tools.description: Search the checkrss.com directory of 1,600+ sites whose feeds the CheckRSS bot fetched and verified, including about 300 Polish sites (national and regional news, tech, business, culture). Match by name, domain, subject or country; filter by category and country. Each result has the site, its feed a

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the categories and subcategories of the checkrss.com feed directory with the number of sites in each and the checkrss.com page of the category, plus the number of sites per country. Use before search_directory to pick a category or subcategory id.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_feed, latest_items, search_directory, list_categories · Public sink: latest_items · Destructive: check_feed, discover_feeds, search_directory.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_feed, latest_items, search_directory, list_categories · Public sink: latest_items · Destructive: check_feed, discover_feeds, search_directory

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
